title: Royal Zahra Kaftan
subtitle: Heritage Craft Meets Modern Grace
description: An opulent full-length kaftan in rich burgundy with hand-embroidered zardozi borders and a flowing bell silhouette — a celebration of Pakistani artisanship.
longDescription: The Royal Zahra Kaftan is a masterpiece of traditional Pakistani craftsmanship modernized for the contemporary woman. Hand-embroidered zardozi gold and silver threadwork frames the neckline, sleeves, and hem in intricate floral motifs. Crafted from luxurious Chiffon-Silk blend fabric that catches the light beautifully with every movement. The relaxed kaftan silhouette is universally flattering and breathable — ideal for summer weddings, mehndi ceremonies, and formal dinners.
careInstructions: Store flat or hanging in garment bag
Do not wring or machine wash
